name: Benone Holiday and Leisure Park
stayType: Council-run holiday park with lodges, pods and pitches
accommodation: 80 electric touring pitches, 18 electric camping pitches, 7 glamping lodges, pods
beachAccess: Next to Benone Strand, reached by boardwalks
confirmedFeatures: Bistro, coffee shop, 9-hole par 3 golf, crazy golf, visitor centre, seasonal splash pools, tennis courts and games room
overview: A council-run park right behind Benone Strand, reached over boardwalks through the dunes. It has 80 electric touring pitches, 18 electric camping pitches, seven glamping lodges and pods. On site there is a bistro and coffee shop, a par 3 golf course and crazy golf, with seasonal splash pools, tennis courts and a games room for families.
surfTripFit: You can walk over the boardwalks to the beach, and the park suits families who want a range of places to stay and things to do.
